text: Connor - driving test Thurs 9am, 3rd attempt, v nervous. text him gd luck the night before
Rosa starts @ Deloitte Mon. ask how 1st wk went
Ming - grade 8 piano exam next Tues. her mum Mrs Ito flying over to watch, staying till the wkend
Graham retiring end of Nov after 31 yrs @ the council. leaving do Fri 28th, collection going round - chip in
Karan - results day Thurs. said he'll ring his dad that morning whatever happens
call w/ Mila. her brother Sam got the promotion - head of sales. she's chuffed for him
Yasmin's audition for the choir was cancelled, director off sick. rescheduled for next Wed

Hassan / Eduardo - both sitting the ACCA paper on Mon. H fine, done loads of past papers. E struggling, hasn't slept properly, his manager's been on at him abt passing first time or the firm won't fund the next one. Eduardo's wife expecting in Jan too so lot on. check on Eduardo the day after, maybe beers Fri
Simone - leaving the bank in a fortnight, new role @ a charity. wants a decent pen for the new desk?? gift idea
Lucy's uni interview went ok she thinks. hears back in 2 wks
Giulia - theory test tomorrow. remind me to ask Giulia how it went afterwards
Kat (Katarzyna) passed her driving test!! 1st go. her dad's lending her the Fiesta
Elijah - 1st day @ the garage was Mon. boss seemed ok, rest of the team not so much. ask him about it Fri

Saskia + her husband Jun - both made redundant same week, same firm. awful timing, they'd just exchanged on the house. Jun has an interview Thurs w/ an insurer in Leeds, would mean relocating. she's still looking, applying for anything. their kids don't know yet. offer to have the kids Thurs so she can go w/ him?
Niamh - dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, home now. she's knackered
Kavya's sister Tanvi sitting her GCSEs from next month - Kavya doing the revision timetable w/ her every evening
pick up dry cleaning Sat, bin day moved to Tues this wk
Oscar - got the job!! starts 3rd Nov. send congrats

Siddharth - medical school interview @ Edinburgh next Thurs. flying up the day before w/ his dad. v anxious about the MMI part, keeps saying he'll freeze on the ethics station. did 2 mocks w/ his cousin Kavya last wkend, she says he's fine. msg him that morning, and ring him the next day to hear how it went
Ilse vegan, Jack coeliac - for the dinner on Sat

Jack - bar exam results out Friday. his partner Chen said he's been a wreck all wk, not eating, checking the portal every hour even though it doesn't open till 9am Fri. Chen's planned a dinner for Sat either way. don't forget to text Jack after, and maybe drop round something nice for Chen too, she's carrying it all
Abdi promoted to sous chef @ Hadiza's restaurant. Hadiza says he's earned it
Juan's leaving drinks were called off - he's staying on after all, they matched the offer
Tadhg - hurling trials Sat morning. his mum driving him, I'm picking him up afterwards
Carmen Gonzalez - starts as deputy head after half term. ask how the first wk goes
me - mock exam Mon for the coaching cert. revise Sun
Connor's girlfriend Rosa - she's doing her PGCE now, placement @ St Mary's. loves it

Ming's dad retiring next month after 40 yrs as a GP, big party planned 3 wks Sat at the golf club. Ming's in charge of the cake + speech, she's stressing, her brother's meant to help but he's useless apparently. her dad has no idea about the party. offered to help w/ the slideshow the wk before
Graham says his grandson Elijah's passed his 11+, starts @ the grammar in Sept
Mila - first day @ Waitrose head office went badly, lost her pass and missed induction. check in w/ her Thurs
Karan + Kavya - their son Oscar starts reception Mon. they're both more nervous than he is lol
Hassan - loves cycling, does the Sunday club rides. hates running
Yasmin's viva is Tues 2pm. she's terrified. need to send her a msg the morning of, then take her for a drink the next day
Eduardo's dad Mr Popescu? no - that's Simone's dad. Mr Popescu has his hip op next Wed, Simone taking the wk off to look after him
Lucy - she failed her driving test again (4th). gutted. don't push it
Giulia's partner Katarzyna started @ the hospital pharmacy, nights for first month
Sam Baker from 5 a side - leaving for Australia Fri, job w/ a mining co. sort a send off before Thurs?
Elijah's cat Pickle went missing Sat, back Mon. he was in bits
chat w/ Saskia - she's going for the grade 5 flute exam in Dec. practising 2 hrs a day. her teacher thinks she's ready

Niamh starts the new job @ Ofcom Mon. her old boss gave her a terrible ref apparently, nearly lost the offer. she's anxious abt the 6 month probation and the commute from Reading. her partner Tadhg doing the school run now so she can get the early train. remind me to ring her end of first wk
Tanvi - got into Bristol for law!! her parents throwing a party next Sat
Kavya - wants the new Sally Rooney for her bday, mentioned it twice
Oscar's mum Mrs Olsen - school says he's being moved up a set in maths. she's thrilled
Siddharth's brother Jun (not that Jun) - first week as a junior doctor, 13hr shifts. he sounds wiped. Sid worried about him
Ilse - quit the agency job, freelancing from Jan. scared but excited

Jack Williams - promotion interview Wed, panel of 3 incl. the new MD. he's up against Graham from accounts, who everyone thinks has it. prep call w/ him Tues eve, go through the case study, then ask how it went Thurs. if he gets it he starts the role in Jan
Chen's mum is having tests at the Royal next Tues - Chen says she won't talk about it. check in w/ Chen that wk
Abdi + Hadiza - their daughter's GCSE results came in, all 7s+. Hadiza cried apparently
car MOT Fri 10am. dentist next Tues. return parcel
Juan - lifeguard assessment this wkend, pool test Sat, written on Sun. ask Juan how the swim went

Tadhg's grandad passed last wk. funeral Thurs in Cork, he's flying over Wed night w/ his sister Niamh. his mum's not coping well, she was the one caring for him. Tadhg off work the whole wk. must send flowers to his mum before Thurs, and check in w/ him once he's back
Carmen - her daughter has her ballet exam Sat. Carmen's taking her, then lunch afterwards
Rosa + Connor - his gran's 90th Sun. they've gone halves on a photo book
Ming - got the job @ the Tate! she starts the wk after next. her mum wants to come for her first day lol
Graham's wife Simone - started her phased retirement, 3 days a wk now. she's loving the garden
Hassan Khan - his son Karan failed his theory, retakes in a fortnight. H a bit cross, Karan just embarrassed

long call w/ Mila tonight. she finally handed in notice - last day is the 14th. boss tried to talk her out of it. new place is a startup, more money but no pension. she's nervous abt the jump but sure it's right. her flatmate Lucy is moving out at the same time so it's all happening at once. should get her a card + something for the new desk. ask her the wk after how it's going
Yasmin's mum - knee replacement 2 wks ago, up and walking now. Yasmin doing her shopping Tues + Fri
note to self - sign up for the first aid course before Fri, deadline

Katarzyna (Kasia) - her brother Elijah's on the stage crew for the school play, opening night next Thurs. she wants us to come. her parents are both away so she's doing the lifts the day before for dress rehearsal and the night itself. Elijah's apparently mortified she's told everyone
